description_excerpt: Job Title Receptionist cum Facility Coordinator (Hanoi / Ha Noi) Job Description Summary Support the day-to-day workplace experience and facilities operations for a leading multinational corporate office in Hanoi. Acting as both the first point of contact for visitors and the on-site facilities representative, this role is responsible for delivering exceptional front-of-house service while ensuring smooth workplace operations, vendor coordination, office administration, and facilities support. Job Description INCO: “Cushman & Wakefield”
